description: - Initialization: Normalize the input matrix; invert it for cost minimization, then
greedily assign each row to its highest-benefit unoccupied column.
- Local Search: Evaluate row swaps versus replacements with unused columns; apply move
type with superior positive gain (batch non-overlapping row swaps).
- Termination: Stop when no move yields positive gain, or upon hitting
Java adapts the NumPy backend for finite double matrices, requires a finite range and a positive batch size, and uses its own random generator or an explicit row order.
